entry.title: Starbucks inventory availability at ‘all-time high’ with daily deliveries, CEO says
entry.summary: The coffeehouse chain has been testing a 24-hour operating model to improve inventory availability and build a faster, more reliable supply chain.

entry.title: Amazon’s first Puerto Rico delivery station speeds up shipping
entry.summary: The 100,000-square-foot site can bring delivery time down to about two days for customers in the San Juan metro area, compared to two weeks.

entry.title: How Brooks Running is using supplier data to address human rights risks
entry.summary: The brand conducts an annual mock detention exercise with suppliers to improve visibility over a broader range of materials and downstream compliance.

entry.title: How Home Depot built the missing logistics piece for its Pro business
entry.summary: Through new flatbed distribution centers, acquisitions and technology, the home improvement retailer has enhanced its last-mile delivery capabilities to better serve contractor customers.

entry.title: Honda invests $462M in Alabama plant to boost production
entry.summary: The automaker will use the funds to increase production capacity of high-demand models.

entry.title: Meta strikes deals to boost low-carbon materials production
entry.summary: The multiyear agreements would cover concrete, plastics and steel and help offset emissions in Meta’s data center supply chain, the Facebook parent company said.

entry.title: Target boosts on-shelf availability, aided by stronger tech
entry.summary: The retailer is using artificial intelligence and advanced data science to make smarter and faster inventory decisions, COO Lisa Roath said.

entry.title: Cal-Maine halts egg production at Florida plant after bird flu outbreak
entry.summary: A resurgence of avian influenza comes as the industry deals with an oversupply of eggs and a crash in consumer prices.

entry.title: Nvidia gets more supplier capacity to meet AI demand
entry.summary: The chipmaker unveiled the latest production agreements a month after securing other deals from partners.

entry.title: Walmart’s sub-30-minute delivery volume surges in Q3
entry.summary: The retailer could speed up deliveries even further with faster pick times at stores, U.S. President and CEO David Guggina said.
